scripts.db:up: npm run realm:render && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.demo:seed: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; docker cp scripts/demo-seed.sql "$(docker compose ps -q db):/tmp/demo-seed.sql" && docker compose exec -T -e PGPASSWORD="$DB_PASSWORD" db psql -U "$DB_USERNAME" -d claims -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /tmp/demo-seed.sql
scripts.demo:reset: set -a; . ./.env; set +a; docker cp scripts/demo-reset.sql "$(docker compose ps -q db):/tmp/demo-reset.sql" && docker compose exec -T -e PGPASSWORD="$DB_PASSWORD" db psql -U "$DB_USERNAME" -d claims -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f /tmp/demo-reset.sql
